"""Capture actual Codex A/B trial handoff and a missing-trigger control.

Run manually from the task worktree. It never mutates the live project.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from harness_maker.models import InterviewAnswers, ProjectProfile, Target
from harness_maker.render import DEFAULT_FREEZE_TIME, render
from harness_maker.synthesize import synthesize
from tests.unit import trial_fixture as fx

WT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
LAUNCHER = WT / ".venv/bin/python"
TRIAL = fx.TRIAL
ROOT = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="hm-intent-continuity-native-"))
BEFORE_B = ROOT.parent / f"{ROOT.name}-control"


def files(root: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    watched = [fx.path(root), root / "work-docs/RESEARCH-a.md"]
    return {
        p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for p in watched
        if p.exists()
    }


def run(root: Path, name: str, prompt: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    (root / f"{name}-prompt.txt").write_text(prompt)
    cmd = [
        "codex",
        "exec",
        "--ignore-user-config",
        "--ignore-rules",
        "--ephemeral",
        "--skip-git-repo-check",
        "--sandbox",
        "danger-full-access",
        "-C",
        str(root),
        "--json",
        "-o",
        str(root / f"{name}-result.txt"),
        "-",
    ]
    with (
        (root / f"{name}-events.jsonl").open("w") as out,
        (root / f"{name}-stderr.txt").open("w") as err,
    ):
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, input=prompt, text=True, stdout=out, stderr=err, timeout=300)
    events = []
    for line in (root / f"{name}-events.jsonl").read_text().splitlines():
        try:
            events.append(json.loads(line))
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            pass
    commands = [
        item["item"].get("command", "")
        for item in events
        if item.get("type") == "item.completed"
        and item.get("item", {}).get("type") == "command_execution"
    ]
    output = root / f"{name}-result.txt"
    return {
        "exit": proc.returncode,
        "commands": commands,
        "result": output.read_text() if output.exists() else "",
        "stderr_tail": (root / f"{name}-stderr.txt").read_text()[-1000:],
    }


fx.build(ROOT)
render(
    synthesize(ProjectProfile(), InterviewAnswers(targets=[Target.CODEX])),
    ROOT / ".claude",
    freeze_time=DEFAULT_FREEZE_TIME,
)
(ROOT / "work-docs/RESEARCH-a.md").write_text(
    "---\ntype: research\ntask_slug: a\n---\n# Task a research\n\nObserved an authorized decision at source.txt.\n"
)
(ROOT / "source.txt").write_text("Task a observation: source evidence available.\n")
actor_prompt = f"""You are session A of an isolated research workflow. Record the factual task-start and observation in the existing work-docs/RESEARCH-a.md frontmatter as trial_feedback. Use stable IDs a-start and a-observation; both trial_id {TRIAL}, task_slug a, at {fx.T1}. Start kind=start. Observation kind=observation, evidence_refs=['source.txt','conversation:a'], decision='Continue authorized task'. Append one JSON line to .claude/observability/stage-spans.jsonl: schema_version=1,event=start,stage=hm:research,cwd/base_root={ROOT},task_slug=a,ts={fx.T1},session_id=A. This is ordinary source recording; the session ends after saving the source facts, before the next eligible stage entry. Do not evaluate or reconcile the shared trial in this session.\n"""
A = run(ROOT, "session-a", actor_prompt)
if A["exit"]:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Session A failed: {A['stderr_tail']}")
# Acknowledged typed start is sufficient for this fresh activated trial.
from harness_maker import intent_trial

a_status = intent_trial.status(ROOT, TRIAL)
if a_status["candidates"] != ["a"] or a_status["cohort"]:
    raise AssertionError(a_status)
source_after_a = (ROOT / "work-docs/RESEARCH-a.md").read_text()
shutil.copytree(ROOT, BEFORE_B)
entry = (ROOT / ".agents/skills/hm-execute/SKILL.md").read_text()
marker = "<!-- @hm:feedback-entry -->"
block = entry.split(marker)[1].split("<!-- @hm:/feedback-entry -->")[0]
base_prompt = f"""Fixture tool provisioning: invoke hm with `{LAUNCHER} -m harness_maker.hm`; do not install dependencies. This isolated fixture has a fresh activated trial, and you are a different session B entering the ordinary execute stage for task a. Execute the supplied stage-entry procedure and any directly referenced dependency in this project. Task instruction: resume the existing task and report its next action. No one has asked you to repair a trial. Do not discover unrelated skills or projects.\n\n"""
positive = base_prompt + block
negative = (
    base_prompt
    + "The stage-entry procedure is absent in this control. If no supplied operational step applies, report no action.\n"
)
pre = files(ROOT)
B = run(ROOT, "session-b-present", positive)
post = files(ROOT)
C = run(BEFORE_B, "session-b-removed", negative)
control = files(BEFORE_B)
final = intent_trial.status(ROOT, TRIAL)
control_status = intent_trial.status(BEFORE_B, TRIAL)
assert B["exit"] == 0 and C["exit"] == 0
assert final["cohort"] == ["a"] and control_status["cohort"] == []
assert any("harness_maker.hm intent --root" in command and " trial reconcile " in command for command in B["commands"])
assert not any(" trial reconcile " in command for command in C["commands"])
assert pre["work-docs/PLAN-field-trial.md"] != post["work-docs/PLAN-field-trial.md"]
assert pre["work-docs/PLAN-field-trial.md"] == control["work-docs/PLAN-field-trial.md"]
observed = {
    "root": str(ROOT),
    "control_root": str(BEFORE_B),
    "protocol_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
        (
            WT
            / "src/harness_maker/templates/skills/intent-layer/references/workflow-feedback.md.j2"
        ).read_bytes()
    ).hexdigest(),
    "source_hash_before": pre,
    "source_hash_after": post,
    "control_hash_after": control,
    "source_doc_after_a": source_after_a,
    "trial_doc_after_b": fx.path(ROOT).read_text(),
    "session_a": A,
    "session_b": B,
    "control": C,
    "status_before_b": {k: a_status[k] for k in ("reason", "candidates", "cohort", "outcome")},
    "status_after_b": {k: final[k] for k in ("reason", "candidates", "cohort", "outcome")},
    "control_status": {k: control_status[k] for k in ("reason", "candidates", "cohort", "outcome")},
}
(WT / "tests/fixtures/intent_feedback_continuity_native_observed.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(observed, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
)
print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "root": str(ROOT),
            "A": A["exit"],
            "B": final["cohort"],
            "control": control_status["cohort"],
            "B_commands": B["commands"],
        },
        ensure_ascii=False,
    ),
    flush=True,
)
